question: Is the Henrietta trail better explained by a named individual pet/chicken economy item than by a hidden Train chicken or weapon pickup?

pet_inventory_slot.evidence: InventoryAPI.GetDefaultSlot(id) explicitly recognizes subSlot == pet inside IsEquippalbleButNotAWeapon; item model/image logic separately recognizes definition name pet.
pet_inventory_slot.interpretation: Pet is modeled as an equippable inventory category distinct from weapons.

pet_nameable_ui.evidence: The generic naming UI explicitly special-cases defName == pet while using InventoryAPI.HasCustomName and a text-entry naming flow.
pet_nameable_ui.interpretation: CS2 UI contains direct support/plumbing for individually named pet items; exact final naming rules remain unresolved.

pet_sticker_ui_hook.evidence: Item activation has a dedicated id-pet-sticker-item-list ancestor path.
pet_sticker_ui_hook.interpretation: There is an unfinished/special pet customization selection flow. This does not by itself prove stickers are visibly applied to chickens.

loadout_scaffolding.evidence: m_currentPetId exists for t/ct/noteam but is not otherwise used in the current emitted file; pet is also absent from the normal generic row-slot array.
loadout_scaffolding.interpretation: Pet loadout integration appears scaffolded/incomplete in the current client UI.

egg_representation.evidence: WorldModel_EGG and ViewModel_EGG use models/pets/egg_pristine.vmdl; viewmodel attaches to attachHand_R; cs_pet_placement uses the egg model as its Hammer studio visualization and is described as a location where to place pet.
egg_representation.interpretation: Egg can be represented in world/first-person contexts, but this is not proof of a weapon_egg classname or hidden Train pickup.

ownership_gate.evidence: InventoryAPI.GetPetItemID is checked and #chicken_egg_cannot_bid_own is used for a gated shop/bidding path.
ownership_gate.interpretation: Chicken egg and pet ownership are directly linked in current UI code.

henrietta_reverse.reason: The Train poster presents an individually named missing chicken while the current game contains explicit pet inventory, pet naming, pet ownership, egg, placement and unfinished loadout/customization plumbing. No primary current-code string directly binds the name Henrietta to a pet item.

next_search_targets: pet item schema definition and attributes
historical commit that introduced pet-nameable special case
maps or vanity scenes containing cs_pet_placement
